turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Hold a calibrated infrared thermometer or contact thermocouple probe against the drive amplifier heatsink surface after the axis has been running under normal load for twenty minutes. Record the heatsink temperature and compare it against the maximum permitted temperature stated in the drive amplifier datasheet.

ground_truth.node_text: Hold a calibrated infrared thermometer or a contact thermocouple probe against the drive amplifier heatsink surface after the axis has been running under normal load for 20 minutes. Record the heatsink temperature and compare against the maximum permitted heatsink temperature stated in the drive amplifier datasheet. An overtemperature condition with normal ambient temperature indicates a failed cooling fan or blocked heatsink fins.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Temperature measurement complete. Heatsink is reading 58 degrees Celsius, which is well below the datasheet limit.

Also inspect the cable route for crush damage, sharp bends, or contact with hot or moving surfaces.

ground_truth.node_text: Inspect the encoder read head status indicator light on the motor body or drive amplifier; green indicates a valid signal and red or flashing indicates a fault. Check the encoder cable continuity at both the motor connector and the drive connector using a continuity tester on each signal wire. Inspect the cable route for crush damage, sharp bends, or contact with hot or moving surfaces.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Encoder inspection complete. Status light is green, all signal wires show good continuity, and the cable route is clear with no visible damage.

ground_truth.node_text: Mount a dial test indicator against the axis slide with the probe oriented along the axis direction. Compare against the maximum permitted backlash value in the axis specification; if exceeded the ballscrew nut preload requires adjustment or replacement.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Backlash test complete. Maximum lost motion recorded is 0.012 millimeters.
